project.title: Wastewater temporal and spatial meta-analysis
project.description: Analyze temporal and spatial dynamics of raw wastewater microbial communities, characterized by 16S rRNA v4v5 gene sequencing, from a five-year time series of two Milwaukee WI USA treatment plants, 71 treatment plants across the USA, and Milwaukee residential sewers.
